Package httyd.battle

Class Combatant

java.lang.Object
httyd.battle.Combatant
public class Combatant extends Object
A dragon during a battle: the owned dragon plus all temporary state (HP, shots, charge, modifiers, damage-over-time). A new instance is created for every dragon in every match.

      field - the battlefield
      Returns:
      the effective value, at least 1

    • addModifier

      public boolean addModifier(Stat stat, double percent, int flat, int turns, boolean selfApplied)
      Adds a stat modifier. A new timed modifier replaces an older timed one of the same stat and direction, so debuffs never pile up.
      Parameters:
      stat - the stat
      percent - percentage fraction (negative for a debuff)
      flat - flat amount
      turns - duration in own turns, or a negative number for permanent
      selfApplied - true if the owner applied it in its own turn (lasts a full turns)
      Returns:
      false if the dragon is immune to the debuff
